stemMd: The author views disagreement in precedent interpretation as

options.label: A
options.textMd: impossible once a prior case exists.

options.label: C
options.textMd: compatible with disciplined reasoning when the competing inferences are made explicit.

options.label: D

options.label: E

explanationMd: The final paragraph allows disagreement after careful analysis. What matters is that it concerns articulated reasons and comparisons, so competing interpretations can be evaluated rather than treated as equally faithful.

distractorRationale.e: Explicit reasoning is the recommended discipline.
distractorRationale.a: The author says disagreement may remain.
distractorRationale.b: The issue is which facts matter and why.
